name: Pogorelec
source:
The protagonist, Voyla - a stalker with a difficult fate - tries to solve the mystery of his wife's disappearance during the cataclysm.

Collect clues, explore the dark corners of the new lands, and unravel the secrets lost among the ruins. Here, in the heart of an abandoned world, you may find not only the answer to Voyla's wife's fate, but also a way to save others from the spawn of the Cataclysm.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3921950/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
主角沃伊拉（Voyla）是一位命运艰难的跟踪者，他试图解开妻子在大灾难中失踪的谜团。

收集线索，探索新大陆的黑暗角落，解开废墟中遗失的秘密。在这里，在一个被遗弃的世界的中心，你不仅可以找到沃伊拉妻子命运的答案，还可以找到从大灾变的根源中拯救他人的方法。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3921950/]Steam[/url]]
